title: PCR Amplification of Long GC-Rich DNA Targets
author: Nadia Assal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbxyippw
materials: QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit

Extract M. bovis genomic DNA using QIAgen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, 50 rxn Qiagen Catalog #69504 according to the manufacturer’s instructions for Gram-positive bacteria. Use 5 ng/µl of genomic DNA was used in each reaction

steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the master mix for PrimeSTAR GXL DNA Polymerase (Catalog #R050A) on ice, ensuring all reagents are vortexed and centrifuged before use.

substeps.instruction: Combine the following components in a reaction tube: Milliq Water (29.5 µl), Buffer (10 µl), DNTPs 2.5mM (4 µl), DMSO (2.5 µl), Primers 25 µM Forward + Reverse (2 µl), Genomic DNA 5ng/ul (1 µl).
Vortex and mix the reaction tubes, ensuring no bubbles are present.

steps.title: Configure Thermal Cycler
steps.instruction: Set the thermal cycler parameters and load the reaction tubes.

substeps.instruction: Set the heating and cooling ramp speed to 2 °C/second.
Program a 2-step protocol for 35-40 cycles: Denaturation at 98 °C for 15 seconds, followed by Annealing and extension at 68 °C for 1 min/kb.
Set the final hold temperature to 4 °C.
Load the tubes and start the program.

steps.title: Analyze PCR Products
steps.instruction: Run the completed reactions on agarose gel electrophoresis.
